scripts.test: sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && cargo test --workspace --all-features && ./node_modules/.bin/bun test && ./node_modules/.bin/bun x tsc --noEmit
scripts.dev:web: test -f crates/clench-wasm/pkg/clench_bg.wasm || sh scripts/build-wasm.sh; vite apps/web
scripts.ext:build:e2e: test -f crates/clench-wasm/pkg/clench_bg.wasm || sh scripts/build-wasm.sh; vite build apps/extension --mode e2e
scripts.apple:test: sh scripts/build-apple.sh --macos-only && cargo build -p clench-cli && cd apps/apple/ClenchKit && swift test
